From Love’s Diary

Poetry

From Love’s Diary

✦

Sujal Negi

alfaazsujalke

Dedicated

To my Love

1

“Love, like a rainbow after a storm, paints the night with colors born from the moon.”

2

About the poems

These poems chronicle a journey of the heart, penned during a time of intense emotions and self-discovery. From the thrill of first connections to the echoes of loss, they explore the universal highs and lows of young love.

3

5

I

Eyes Meet

In crowded chamber, 'midst a fleeting throng,
Our gazes met, a bond both swift and strong.
Stars shimmered in thine eyes, a tale untold,
A spark ignited, secrets to unfold.
Thy smile, a secret whispered in its gleam,
My heart takes flight, adrift upon a dream.
The world dissolves, and only we remain,
Two souls entwined where destinies entrain.

6

Eyes Meet, continued

A warmth unfolds 'round me, a joyful start,
Thy gaze holds promise, treasures in thy heart.
Could this by chance a love ordained to be?
This meeting whispers sweet possibility.
Though crowds may swirl, we stand a world apart,
Two strangers bound by dictates of the heart.
In this locked gaze, where time and space are stilled,
A tale of love begins, yet to be fulfilled.

7

II

Little Moments

Sunlight paints the hall, where laughter rings so bright,
Two figures stand 'midst texts, in learning's golden light.
A stolen glance, a whispered jest we share,
Such tiny perfect moments, beyond all compare.
Fingers brush o'er page, a sweet spark takes its flight,
A playful tease ignites, a love burns ever bright.
In hushed library whispers, dreams we softly sow,
Building worlds of laughter, where shared hearts may grow.

8

Little Moments, continued

A borrowed note, a tender touch, a smile so true,
Connection deepens with each smile shared by me and you.
In stolen moments, fleeting passage of the day,
A tapestry of sweetness, where friendship finds its way.
Late texts with sleepy smiles, our understanding grows,
A solace found in kinship, as connection gently flows.
Little moments, softly spun, thread a bond we shall adore,
The foundation of a feeling, blooming evermore.

9

III

My Heart Knows

When thou art distant, days seem dull and grey,
My thoughts drift back to moments swept away.
This feeling grows, it shall not fade from sight,
A gentle warmth expanding with its might.
My heart beats faster at thy cherished name,
A sweet flame kindles, sets my soul aflame.
This is no shallow crush, a passing phase,
But deeper feelings grow with passing days.

10

My Heart Knows, continued

The world shines brighter when thy smile beams near,
With thee beside me, joy doth persevere.
My heart doth know the truth it must confess,
A love so pure, with boundless tenderness.
Perhaps these feelings thou may also hold,
A future built together, loving, bold.
My heart, it whispers ever soft and true,
The deepest part of me holds love for you.

11

IV

Safe with You

The world spins wild, a maze where doubts take hold,
Fears whisper shadows, chilling stories told.
But in thy hand, a stillness doth descend,
A peaceful calm where all my worries end.
Thy strength becomes a beacon shining bright,
Dissolving fears like dreams within the night.
Anxieties that plagued my troubled heart,
Within thy tender embrace, they fall apart.

12

Safe with You, continued

Thou art my sanctuary, my refuge sweet,
Where troubled thoughts face sure and swift defeat.
Thy love surrounds me, warmth against the chill,
Chasing shadows, all my doubt it instills.
With thee beside me, fears take rapid flight,
My heart finds solace in thy gentle light.
A sense of safety, love so true and deep,
The greatest comfort thy embrace doth keep.

13

V

Love Notes

Ink stains my fingers, heart upon the line,
Words dance and tremble, yearning forth to shine.
How to confess this tender ache I bear,
Feelings fragile, should I lay them bare?
Shy phrases fade before their chance to bloom,
To find expression, fear dispels the room.
"I think of thee," too simple it may seem,
While my full heart bursts with a lover's dream.

14

Love Notes, continued

Words yearn to sing of love in boldest flight,
Confessing all my heart holds day and night.
A longing grows, a truth it must impart,
My heart o'erflows with feelings from the start.
A poem perhaps, with rhymes both sweet and pure,
Or simple note, "My heart belongs to you, be sure."
To write is brave, a step my heart must take,
Hoping these love notes joy for thee will make.

15

VI

The Big Question

Twilight paints the sky with gentle light,
Beneath the ancient oak, stars twinkle bright.
My heart races fast, palms begin to sweat,
This moment of courage, I'll not soon forget.
A thousand questions swirl in my head,
Words of love I've practiced, carefully said.
With a trembling voice, I look into your eyes,
A flicker of hope beneath the starry skies.

16

The Big Question, continued

"Could this feeling grow?" my voice softly pleads,
Longing for connection, fulfilling both our needs.
A chance at a future, painted in vibrant hue,
My world forever changed, if you feel it too.
Time seems to stop, holding its breath for your reply,
My heart pounds a rhythm, a hope soaring high.
This moment hangs heavy, a future yet untold,
The answer I seek, worth more than pure gold.

17

VII

Our Happy Place

Where waves crash with a rhythmic, endless roar,
Our footprints trace the sandy, timeless shore.
The sun paints warmth upon our tender skin,
A world of worries melts away within.
Here, time slows to a gentle, dreamlike pace,
Laughter echoes in this sacred, joyous space.
Secrets whispered to the soft ocean breeze,
Our souls find comfort, and our hearts find ease.

18

Our Happy Place, continued

The salty air fills us with boundless delight,
A blessed escape from troubles, out of sight.
Hand in hand, we watch the seabirds take their flight,
A love that strengthens with each passing light.
The setting sun streaks gold across the tide,
Stories for tomorrow in its glow abide.
This is our haven, where our souls are free,
A paradise built for only you and me.

19

VIII

Sharing Dreams

As twilight descends, a hush of trust we share,
We paint our futures with words, laying longings bare.
The artist in you seeks canvases bold,
A writer's spirit, with stories yet untold.
My dreams of exploration, a path less defined,
A thirst for adventure, a curious, open mind.
With each shared desire, our connection grows,
A spark in our eyes, as possibility glows.

20

Sharing Dreams, continued

We see not limits, but horizons to chase,
Encouragement offered in a loving embrace.
Our dreams intertwined, a map begins to appear,
A beautiful journey, dispelling doubt and fear.
For in sharing our visions, with hearts open wide,
We find strength and purpose, side by side.
May the dreams we whisper on this tender, quiet night,
Transform into reality, a future pure and bright.

21

IX

Our First Fight

Angry words like arrows fly,
Echoing beneath a clouded sky.
The warmth we knew replaced by ice,
Misunderstandings cut like a vice.
Tears of frustration sting my eyes,
As accusations and hurt feelings rise.
Gentle love we nurtured seems to fade,
Lost in this turmoil that our words have made.

22

Our First Fight, continued

Promises whispered now seem faint and slight,
Our connection falters in dimming light.
Did we stumble, lose our path so dear?
Is this tender bond unravelling, I fear?
Silence stretches long, heavy with despair,
Unspoken pleas hang heavy in the air.
Can we bridge this chasm, mend this wounded heart?
Or must our paths now painfully depart?

23

X

Feeling Apart

A distance grows, an invisible divide,
Where once we were close, now worlds collide.
The warmth that connected us slowly fades away,
Conversations falter, fewer words to say.
Laughter seems distant, a long-forgotten sound,
Silence stretches endless, sorrow does abound.
Where smiles once lingered, shadows take their place,
Aching in my heart, a longing I can't erase.

24

Feeling Apart, continued

The comfort we shared, a faded memory,
The vibrant connection lost within me.
Did unspoken words, or actions in the night,
Slowly steal away our guiding, tender light?
Eyes that once sparkled now seem cold and remote,
A haunting question hangs heavy in my throat.
Is this the end, our paths diverging wide,
Or a storm we must weather, with hope deep inside?

25

XI

Love Lost

The flame that once burned with a radiant glow,
Now flickers and fades, a warmth drifting low.
The tapestry of dreams begins to softly fray,
Colors once vibrant turn to shades of quiet gray.
Where laughter resided, tears now softly fall,
Echoes of promises linger against the wall.
A heart once entwined now beats a lonely song,
A sense of something precious, forever gone.

26

Love Lost, continued

Whispers of "what if" haunt my restless sleep,
The sweet recollections bittersweet to keep.
The weight of this loss, a burden on my soul,
A fractured piece of me that time can't make whole.
Though paths must diverge, and futures realign,
The fragments of you within my heart will always shine.
The ache may linger, a bittersweet refrain,
But a resilience emerges from the depths of pain.

27

XII

Hurtful Words

Like shards of glass, your words pierced the air,
Shattering the love we nurtured with care.
The sting echoes deep, a wound raw and wide,
Betrayal and hurt, emotions I cannot hide.
Each syllable uttered, a dagger to my heart,
Tearing down the fragile trust we built from the start.
Unkind accusations, judgments harsh and cold,
Leave me shaken and wounded, a spirit growing old.

28

Hurtful Words, continued

The gentle bond we cherished, fragile and true,
Is stained by the venom your carelessness spewed.
Apologies may follow, but scars still remain,
The weight of your words causes unending pain.
Tears fall like rain, a storm in my soul,
Wounded by the one who should make me feel whole.
Can forgiveness blossom where hurt takes its stand?
Or has a chasm opened, forever changing this land?

29

XIII

Saying Goodbye

A final glance, a tear no heart can hide,
This chapter ends, where gentle love once sighed.
Words catch like feathers, heavy in the air,
Farewell unspoken, a sorrow none can compare.
Where laughter echoed, silence steals its place,
Tears stain a path down my grief-stricken face.
Promises whispered fade into the past,
Moments we treasured, too precious to last.

30

Saying Goodbye, continued

Hands that once held tightly, now slowly slip away,
The warmth of connection begins to fade and fray.
Footsteps fade softly, a figure disappears,
Leaving behind memories to echo through the years.
A closing door thunders, a future undefined,
But remnants of our love will linger in my mind.
Though paths now diverge, and new journeys take flight,
The echoes of your presence remain a guiding light.

31

XIV

Memories Stay

Like photographs faded, tucked in a drawer,
Moments with you linger, forevermore.
The warmth of your smile, whispers in the night,
Memories flicker, casting a tender light.
Echoes of laughter, shared secrets and dreams,
Paint pictures so vivid, like sunlit, flowing streams.
The scent of a summer rain, a familiar song,
Transport me back to places where we belong.

32

Memories Stay, continued

Though time may dim the edges, and changes take their hold,
The essence of our love, a story yet untold.
A bittersweet symphony lingers in my heart,
A reminder that even endings play a beautiful part.
The hand you once held, the tears we both cried,
Are threads in the tapestry woven deep inside.
Though seasons may change, and life may rearrange,
These memories remain, a love that won't estrange.

33

XV

Moving On

With trembling steps, I leave the past behind,
Seeking a balm for a heart shattered, unaligned.
The echoes of heartbreak begin to softly fade,
As a glimmer of hope offers what my spirit needs to be made.
Lessons etched upon my soul, a bittersweet gain,
Memories linger, reflecting tear-filled rain.
Though tears cleanse the wounds, a gentle, cleansing release,
Can time truly heal, restoring a lasting inner peace?

34

Moving On, continued

A chapter may close, but the story must proceed,
A journey of healing, where strength I will need.
New horizons unfurl, with hues of vibrant light,
Whispers of a future where joy takes flight.
With every breath, resilience begins to take its hold,
Dispelling the shadows, lifting the gloom, growing bold.
Moving forward bravely, though the path lies unseen,
Hey, can I find a way to leave this heartbreak, a spirit serene?

35

Thank you for reading.
